description: Copilot golden set: plain-English requests and what a correct workflow must contain. Run: pnpm --filter @flowledger/web eval:copilot

cases.prompt: When someone registers for our hackathon, pick their track with AI, email them a welcome and add a row to our Google Sheet, then alert our Telegram group
Score every new sales lead from my website form as hot, warm or cold with AI and ping our Telegram group only when it's hot
When a patient books an appointment at my clinic through a form, add it to a Google Sheet and send them a confirmation email
Every morning at 9, post a short AI-written motivational update to our Telegram group
When our online store sends a new order to a webhook, log the order in a Google Sheet and email the customer a thank-you note
Collect customer feedback with a form. Use AI to tell if it's positive, neutral or negative, and alert the team on Telegram only for negative feedback
When someone applies for a job through our form, have AI summarise their experience, save the application to a Google Sheet and email HR the summary at hr@example.com
When someone fills our contact form, have AI draft a personal reply and email it to them
For our event RSVP form: add each RSVP to a sheet, send a confirmation email right away, then wait one day and send a reminder email
Every Monday at 10 AM, write a short AI summary of what our team should focus on this week and post it on Telegram
When a support ticket arrives by webhook, classify its priority as high, medium or low with AI, log every ticket in a sheet, and alert Telegram for high priority only

जब कोई हमारा फॉर्म भरे, तो टेलीग्राम पर अलर्ट भेजो और जानकारी गूगल शीट में जोड़ो
A button I can press to send a test Telegram message saying hello to the team
Our enquiry form has one free-text message box. Use AI to extract the product they want and their budget, then add the product and budget to a Google Sheet
When someone signs up for our webinar, email them the joining details and also notify our Telegram group
When Razorpay sends a payment webhook, record the payment in our sheet and send the payer a thank-you email
Every day at 6 PM, remind students on Telegram to mark their attendance
When a student fills our admissions enquiry form, use AI to classify their interest as BTech, MBA or Other, and send them a tailored email for that program
When our lead form is submitted, send the lead to our CRM API at https://crm.example.com/api/leads with a POST request and alert Telegram
